product_overview: FreshNextJS is a Next.js-based education and content platform that lets visitors browse featured courses, philosophical lectures, and pricing information. It also supports user account creation and credential-based sign-in for accessing authenticated areas like the dashboard.
core_goals: Browse the public site to discover featured courses and lectures

features.name: Landing Page Navigation
features.description: Allows visitors to explore the public home page and move to key sections of the site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View featured courses and lectures -> Open the courses catalog
Navigate to / -> View featured courses and lectures -> Open the lectures directory
Navigate to / -> View featured courses and lectures -> Open the pricing plans page
Navigate to / -> View featured courses and lectures -> Open the login page
Navigate to / -> View featured courses and lectures -> Open the registration page

features.name: Admin/User Login
features.description: Allows returning users to sign in with email or username and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email or username -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See a sign-in failure message

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allows new visitors to create an account with basic profile and login credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter email -> Enter username -> Enter name -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-up form -> See account creation success and continue to sign in
Navigate to /register -> Enter an email that is already in use -> Submit the sign-up form -> See a validation message
